    thor v74: submitter carried from the queue slot; exit reasons to console; wake enqueue receipt
    
    v73 field results: audiomxd stable (one PID, no crashes), SpringBoard
    reached the window-scene connection flow, first visible frame earlier
    (79 s vs 90 s) - but the EMPTIED submitter line answered '?/-1'
    because presenter() copies the swap into a static buffer before show()
    and v73 reverse-looked that address up in the queue; and the PONG EXIT
    records were never retrieved because the phone's Recovery does not
    export the ramoops range Darwin writes (0x85200000 vs actual pstore at
    0xa7000000 - an address contract that needs loader/Darwin/Recovery
    alignment, deliberately not patched).
    
    - kernel: presenter() now copies the submitter name+pid out of the
      same slot under the same lock and passes them to show() explicitly;
      the transition line prints the real requester of the next EMPTIED.
    - kernel: the bounded original exit reason is ALSO printed to the
      console (PongConsole captures it); the ramoops write stays.
    - lib: a 'wake enqueue returned' receipt completes the scheduling pair
      (scheduled -> enqueue returned -> begin).
    
    boot v74 (e663ccff, kernel 1775e35c) + userdata v22 (3f6e7db9) with
    lib v74 (57a2be64).
